info.title: Zeus Local API
info.description: Local JSON API for managing Hermes bot profiles and gateway lifecycle.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: Present only when Zeus replays a stored idempotent response.

CacheControl.description: JSON API responses must not be cached.

RetryAfter.description: Present for an in-progress idempotent request or server capacity/shutdown rejection; other 503 errors do not include this header.

ZeusApiKey.name: x-zeus-api-key
ZeusApiKey.description: Administrator ZEUS_API_KEY or a named integration credential. Named credentials require the operation-specific x-zeus-permission; identities and permissions come from server configuration, not request headers. Keep keys server-side.

dispatch_state.description: Persisted prepared receipts are observed as unknown without updating storage.

run_id.description: Acknowledged Hermes run identifier; null before acceptance.

run_status.description: Last persisted observation, never refreshed by this API; null before acceptance.

retry_before.description: Persisted retry deadline, not permission or a guarantee that retry remains safe.

last_checked_at.description: Time of the last durable execution-status observation; null when none exists.

cancel_requested_at.description: Recorded cancellation intent, not evidence that execution stopped.

released_at.description: Local release of the admission blocker, not evidence that execution stopped.

archived_at.description: Archival time. Archived receipts remain readable but no longer count against admission capacity.

error_code.description: Bounded stored error code; no free-form error details.

next_before.description: Exclusive cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted. Preserve bot_id and pass this value unchanged.

limit.description: Maximum unarchived receipts admitted by the store.

used.description: Unarchived receipts, including completed or rejected receipts that have not been archived.

remaining.description: max(0, limit - used); observation reserves no capacity.

total.description: All durable receipts, equal to used + archived.

blocking.description: Unreleased unknown/prepared receipts and accepted runs without a terminal stored status.

status.description: ok below 80% used, warning at 80%, critical at 95%, full at or above the limit.

database_bytes.description: Observed database file size, or null if unavailable.

wal_bytes.description: Observed WAL file size; zero if absent, null if unavailable.

filesystem_free_bytes.description: Observed free bytes available to the service user, or null if unavailable. Filesystem observations are not part of the SQLite snapshot.

path.description: Canonical unprefixed route template; the /v1 alias has identical access.

permission.description: Required permission. authenticated accepts any valid credential and is not a configurable credential scope.

mutates_state.description: Whether the operation can change lifecycle/domain state or initialize/migrate the database. False is not a promise of zero filesystem writes: access logs and runtime lock bookkeeping can still occur.

zeus_version.description: Version of the running Zeus package. Discovery does not replace the consumer version compatibility gate.

schema_version.description: Schema supported by the running package; this does not check the actual database. Use /ready for readiness.

integration_id.description: Identity derived from the authenticated credential; admin denotes the legacy administrator.

permissions.description: Effective independent scopes, sorted by name.

endpoints.description: Only protected endpoints available to the authenticated caller, ordered by method then path. Public /health is omitted.

desired_state.description: Persisted operator intent for the gateway.

converged.description: True only when observed status matches desired state.

reason.description: Stable diagnostic outcome code; no upstream error body.

get.description: Newest first by created_at, then message_id descending. Archived receipts are included. One read-only SQLite snapshot per request; later pages may reflect later writes. Preserve the bot_id filter across pages. Requires observer permission or administrator authentication even when ZEUS_ALLOW_UNAUTH_READS=1. Reads existing durable evidence without dispatch, execution refresh, recovery, database initialization, or migration. Normal API logging still applies.

parameters.name: bot_id
parameters.description: Optional exact bot ID filter; does not change authorization scope.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Opaque exclusive cursor from next_before. The receipt must exist and match the bot_id filter, if supplied.

400.description: Malformed request or identifier (invalid_request); unknown cursor or cursor outside bot_id filter (invalid_cursor)

403.description: The authenticated integration lacks observer permission (permission_denied)

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying authentication.

503.description: Receipt storage is missing, corrupt, or incompatible (message_store_unavailable); no server credential is configured, or server capacity/shutdown prevents handling. Retry-After is only present for server capacity/shutdown rejection.

get.description: Accepts no query parameters. Counts the entire retained receipt history, including archived rows, within a cooperative two-second budget covering SQLite work, lock waiting and validation. Returns exact counts or an error; never reserves capacity. Filesystem size/free-space observations can differ from the SQLite snapshot. Requires observer permission or administrator authentication even when ZEUS_ALLOW_UNAUTH_READS=1. Reads existing durable evidence without dispatch, execution refresh, recovery, database initialization, or migration. Normal API logging still applies.

403.description: The authenticated integration lacks observer permission (permission_denied)

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying authentication.

503.description: Receipt storage is missing, corrupt, or incompatible (message_store_unavailable); the cooperative two-second capacity read budget expired (message_read_budget_exceeded), with no partial totals; no server credential is configured, or server capacity/shutdown prevents handling. Retry-After is only present for server capacity/shutdown rejection.

get.description: Accepts no query parameters. Archived receipts remain addressable. Returns only the public receipt fields: no prompts, outputs, gateway endpoints, credentials, fingerprints, idempotency keys, leases, or storage version. Requires observer permission or administrator authentication even when ZEUS_ALLOW_UNAUTH_READS=1. Reads existing durable evidence without dispatch, execution refresh, recovery, database initialization, or migration. Normal API logging still applies.

get.description: Always requires a valid API credential, including when development unauthenticated reads are enabled. Uses only loaded configuration and package constants: no database read, gateway probe, execution refresh, dispatch, or recovery. No query parameters. Returns the caller identity, never other integration identities or keys.
